summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which detects platform/arch (including Alpine musl), downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun` releases into a temp directory, extracts and chmods it executable, then invokes the downloaded Bun binary against sibling `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line obfuscated bundle (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, rotated string-array with a `WV8StW` shuffle dispatcher). Both payload files (`setup.mjs`, `math_init.js`) sit at the tarball root outside the `package.json` `files: ["lib"]` allowlist — the declared publish manifest does not include them. The scope `@ornikar/*` re-packages the unrelated upstream `apollo-link-timeout` under an organization scope not associated with the original author. On `npm install`, arbitrary obfuscated code executes on the installer's machine via a freshly-downloaded alien runtime, bypassing Node-level inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
